name: ProjectUAI
description: Project UAI is a universal AI agent that runs directly inside Roblox. It brings a Claude Code–style agent loop to the Roblox client, allowing AI models to inspect, interact with, and automate Roblox environments through native tools. Connect virtually any OpenAI-compatible provider or custom endpoint, choose your model, and let the agent reason.

paragraphs: A universal AI agent that runs inside a Roblox client. It works in any game, with Chat Completions and Anthropic Messages endpoints, including compatible local servers and relays.

Version 3.2.0 — October 15, 2026: Project UAI Free and OpenCode desktop. Start chatting with Project UAI Free without supplying an API key. It is the default when no provider is configured and uses HCNSEC's shared auto router. Thank you for continuing to use and support Project UAI. Capacity and response speed vary; more free providers may become available soon. Join our Discord for help, provider news and updates.

OpenCode's direct desktop workaround uses the verified desktop identity and keeps its required compatibility tool declarations, without requiring the bridge. The Windows bridge adds an optional path through an installed OpenCode CLI server; the CLI binary is not packaged. OpenCode free models are unsupported on mobile, including the Android companion. The retired OpenCode proxy is removed; only AgentRouter uses the proxy's proper domain. Saved OpenCode proxy URLs migrate back to Zen.

requirements.text: Registration requires a GitHub account at least one year old; its recommended model is deepseek-v4-flash.
Compatibility fixtures require no models, keys or paid inference.
